meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'радоваться'). Used in Russian as a perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to be delighted', forming an aspectual pair with 'радоваться'. The reflexive suffix '-ся'/'-сь' makes the action intransitive, reciprocal, or directed at the subject.

examples.trans: Vika was thrilled with the new famous guest.

examples.text: Администратор очень обрадовалась такому важному гостю.

meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'рушиться').
